purpose: Correct the earlier asymmetric baseline comparison and isolate alignment-method effects from tokenizer effects.

split_policy.development: May be used only for pipeline validation and interpretation-rule debugging.
split_policy.heldout_test: Run once after the Stage 1 implementation and reporting rules pass development checks; do not tune on these outcomes.

task_conditions.contiguous: Use the frozen canonical target and all frozen original-text gold intervals.

one_gap.name: central_whitespace_token_deletion
one_gap.eligibility: At least three maximal non-whitespace target chunks.
one_gap.rule: Delete chunk floor(n / 2), join retained chunks with one ASCII space, and retain the original target's outer gold interval.
one_gap.still_contiguous_policy: If the deleted target remains an exact normalized source substring elsewhere, label it one_gap_still_contiguous_control and exclude it from the primary one_gap condition.
one_gap.interpretation: Controlled one-gap recovery, not a model of the full distribution of LLM errors.

task_conditions.llmarkers_positive_label: For records whose frozen inventory has all_verified=true, evaluate group_label and feature_label separately against source_rationale. This inventory is positive-only and is not independent semantic gold.

boundary_stripped_whitespace.definition: Whitespace chunks with non-word characters removed only from each chunk's left and right boundaries; internal punctuation is retained.

punctuation.definition: Case-sensitive words/numbers/underscore and individual punctuation tokens (regex \w+|[^\w\s]).

scibert.label: SciBERT
scibert.verbatim_surface_policy: Pair the uncased token ID with its normalized original-case surface so case-different and unknown surfaces do not count as equal verbatim tokens.
scibert.contextual_target_retry: none; frozen probes show leading whitespace does not change token IDs

pubmedbert.label: PubMedBERT (repository now named BiomedBERT)
pubmedbert.verbatim_surface_policy: Pair the uncased token ID with its normalized original-case surface so case-different and unknown surfaces do not count as equal verbatim tokens.
pubmedbert.contextual_target_retry: none; frozen probes show leading whitespace does not change token IDs

normalized_exact_substring.definition: Character-level exact substring search after declared normalization; evaluated once per task and not attributed to a tokenizer.

taln.definition: Enumerate injective order-preserving equal-token correspondences. A task succeeds if any candidate covers every target token.
taln.compact_run: Count paths with capped dynamic programming and materialize one diagnostic path; test all gold outer intervals without requiring full materialization.

lcs.definition: One deterministic longest common token subsequence; full target coverage is required.

difflib.definition: Python difflib.SequenceMatcher matching blocks with autojunk=false; full target coverage is required.

semi_global_exact.definition: Token-exact target-global/source-semi-global alignment. Match=+1, skipped source token=-1, source prefixes/suffixes free, mismatches and target gaps forbidden.
semi_global_exact.success: A finite full-target path succeeds even when its score is zero or negative.
semi_global_exact.tie_break: Fewest skipped source tokens, then earliest first source token, then lexicographically smallest source-index path.

metrics.primary: full_lexical_support: complete equality of the case-preserving target token sequence under the declared tokenizer; whitespace discarded by a tokenizer is not reintroduced as a second method-dependent criterion
metrics.localization_note: Any-candidate localization is an enumerative capability for taln; selected-path localization for one-path baselines is descriptive and is not interpreted as an algorithmic accuracy comparison.
